declarations.name: MathResearch.Fueter.TwoSidedRegularOn
declarations.display_text:
def TwoSidedRegularOn (f : ℍ → ℍ) (U : Set ℍ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U ∧
    (∀ q ∈ U, leftOperator f q = 0) ∧ (∀ q ∈ U,
        rightOperator f q = 0)

declarations.display_text:
def multiIndexPartial (α : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (ℍ → ℍ) → (ℍ →
    ℍ) :=
  iteratedPartial (List.replicate (α 0) 0 ++
      List.replicate (α 1) 1 ++
    List.replicate (α 2) 2 ++ List.replicate (α 3) 3)
